text = "Maria Chen joined Northwind Freight, a company in Chicago."
found = ThinkThen.recognize(text, kinds: %w[person organization place],
  relations: { works_for: %w[person organization],
               based_in: %w[organization place] })
# 1 Maria Chen, a person; 2 Northwind Freight, an
# organization; 3 Chicago, a place
found.entities.each { |name| puts "#{name.id} #{name.text} #{name.kind}" }
# works_for 1 → 2, and based_in 2 → 3
found.relations.each { |link| puts "#{link.name} #{link.source} #{link.target}" }
